summary: AAP 2.6 external databases need ICU support, and PostgreSQL user passwords are hashed with SCRAM-SHA-256. Check controller database access with `awx-manage check_db`; database size grows with hosts, jobs, facts and tasks (hourly 20-task jobs on 250 hosts write over 800,000 events a week), so clean old jobs and facts with management jobs.
questions: How do I check controller can reach its database?
How fast does the AAP database grow?
Does AAP need ICU support in PostgreSQL?
